title: msg POST ignores Content-Format
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py

Robustness: MessagesResource.render_post and MessageReceiptsResource.render_post decode request.payload as CBOR with no check of request.opt.content_format. Spec 18.1.2 / 18.1.3 examples and resource advertisements use Content-Format 60 (application/cbor). Sibling PresenceResource.render_put rejects a present non-CBOR Content-Format with 4.00.

Impact: a client that sends CF=0 (text/plain) or SenML 112 with CBOR-looking bytes is accepted and mutates inbox/sent/receipts. Wrong-format payloads that happen to be valid CBOR maps are stored as messages.

Not covered by l9dn (field types inside a CBOR map).
acceptance_criteria: POST /msg/inbox, POST /msg/sent, POST /messages, and POST /msg/ack with a present Content-Format other than 60 return 4.00 and do not mutate inbox, sent, receipts, or _next_id. Missing Content-Format MAY still be accepted as CBOR (RFC 7252 default) or rejected; pick one and test it. PresenceResource CF check is the local pattern.
